questions.question: 다음 중 IIA가 정의하는 내부감사의 핵심 요소가 아닌 것은?
questions.question_en: Which of the following is NOT a core element of the IIA's definition of internal auditing?
options: 조직의 운영 개선 및 가치 부가
options_en: Independent, objective assurance and consulting activity
Adding value and improving the organization's operations
Issuing an opinion on the external financial statements
Evaluating the effectiveness of risk management, control, and governance processes
questions.explanation: 외부 재무제표에 대한 의견 인증은 외부감사인(CPA)의 영역. 내부감사는 독립적·객관적 보증 및 컨설팅을 통해 조직의 가치 부가와 운영 개선을 목표로 한다.
questions.explanation_en: Issuing an opinion on the external financial statements is the responsibility of external auditors (CPAs). Internal auditing aims to add value and improve operations through independent, objective assurance and consulting.

questions.question: 최고감사책임자(CAE)의 보고체계 중 독립성을 가장 잘 보장하는 구조는?
questions.question_en: Which CAE reporting structure best ensures independence?
options_en: Both functionally and administratively to the CEO
Functionally to the board / audit committee, administratively to the CEO
Both functionally and administratively to the CFO
Both functionally and administratively to the external auditor
questions.explanation: IIA 권고: 기능적(functional)으로는 이사회/감사위원회에, 행정적(administrative)으로는 CEO에게 보고하는 이중 보고체계가 독립성을 가장 잘 보장한다.
questions.explanation_en: IIA recommendation: a dual reporting structure — functionally to the board/audit committee and administratively to the CEO — best safeguards independence.

questions.question: IIA Code of Ethics의 4대 원칙에 포함되지 않는 것은?
questions.question_en: Which is NOT one of the 4 principles of the IIA Code of Ethics?
questions.explanation: IIA 윤리강령 4대 원칙: Integrity, Objectivity, Confidentiality, Competency. 수익성은 윤리 원칙이 아니다.
questions.explanation_en: The 4 principles are Integrity, Objectivity, Confidentiality, and Competency. Profitability is not an ethics principle.

questions.question: Three Lines Model(2020 개정)에서 내부감사의 위치는?
questions.question_en: In the Three Lines Model (2020 revision), where does internal audit sit?
options_en: Second Line — risk and compliance functions
A separate line directly under the governing body
questions.explanation: 내부감사는 3선(Third Line)에 위치하며 독립적 보증을 제공한다. 1선은 운영 관리, 2선은 위험관리·컴플라이언스 등 지원 기능.
questions.explanation_en: Internal audit is the Third Line, providing independent assurance. The First Line is operational management; the Second Line is risk, compliance, and other support functions.

questions.question: 내부감사인이 6개월 전까지 구매부서장으로 근무했다. 즉시 구매부서에 대한 보증 감사 약속을 수행할 수 있는가?
questions.question_en: An internal auditor served as head of the purchasing department until 6 months ago. May they immediately perform an assurance engagement of purchasing?
options: 불가능 — 통상 12개월 이상 경과해야 객관성 보장
불가능 — 영구히 해당 부서 감사 불가
options_en: Yes — being currently in the audit department is sufficient
Yes — only CAE approval is required
No — typically at least 12 months must pass to safeguard objectivity
No — the auditor may never audit that department
questions.explanation: IIA Standard 1130.A1: 자신이 책임졌던 활동에 대한 보증 약속은 객관성이 손상된 것으로 간주되며, 통상 최소 12개월 이상 경과해야 한다.
questions.explanation_en: Per IIA Standard 1130.A1, objectivity is presumed impaired for assurance engagements covering an area for which the auditor was previously responsible — typically at least 12 months must pass.

questions.question: COSO 내부통제 통합프레임워크의 5대 구성요소가 아닌 것은?
questions.question_en: Which is NOT one of the 5 components of the COSO Internal Control - Integrated Framework?
questions.explanation: COSO 5대 요소: 통제환경, 위험평가, 통제활동, 정보 및 의사소통, 모니터링 활동. 외부감사는 포함되지 않는다.
questions.explanation_en: The five COSO components are Control Environment, Risk Assessment, Control Activities, Information & Communication, and Monitoring Activities. External Audit is not one of them.

questions.question: 예방통제(Preventive Control)에 해당하는 것은?
questions.question_en: Which of the following is a Preventive Control?
options_en: Automated alert report on unusual transactions
questions.explanation: 직무분리는 부정·오류 발생 자체를 사전에 방지하는 예방통제. 대사·예외 보고서·내부감사는 발견통제.
questions.explanation_en: Segregation of duties prevents fraud and errors before they occur — a preventive control. Reconciliations, exception reports, and internal audits are detective controls.

questions.question: IIA QAIP에서 요구하는 외부 평가의 최소 주기는?
questions.question_en: What is the minimum frequency of external assessments required by the IIA QAIP?
questions.explanation: Standard 1312: 최소 5년에 1회 이상 외부 평가가 필요하다.
questions.explanation_en: Standard 1312 requires external assessments at least once every five years.

questions.question: 부정 트라이앵글(Fraud Triangle)의 3요소 중 내부통제 설계로 가장 직접 줄일 수 있는 것은?
questions.question_en: Which element of the Fraud Triangle can be most directly reduced through internal control design?
questions.explanation: 통제 설계는 주로 '기회(Opportunity)'를 축소하는 데 효과적이다. 압박과 합리화는 개인적·환경적 요인으로 통제로 직접 다루기 어렵다.
questions.explanation_en: Control design is most effective at reducing Opportunity. Pressure and Rationalization are individual or environmental factors that are difficult to address with controls directly.

questions.question: 고유위험(Inherent Risk)과 잔여위험(Residual Risk)의 관계는?
questions.question_en: What is the relationship between Inherent Risk and Residual Risk?
options_en: Residual and Inherent are the same concept
questions.explanation: 잔여위험은 고유위험에 통제를 적용한 후 남는 위험. 감사인은 잔여위험이 조직의 위험 수용도(risk appetite) 내에 있는지 평가한다.
questions.explanation_en: Residual risk is the risk remaining after controls are applied to inherent risk. Auditors evaluate whether residual risk is within the organization's risk appetite.
